messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — final 'lift-off' checklist for GA tomorrow. I want confirmation on SLA, docs, support rota, monitoring alerts, and pricing page go-live. Can owners ack?
Ben: SLA doc is drafted in Google Drive, link: https://drive.google.com/xxx; SLA targets: 99.9% availability, p99 latency < 200ms for small models. Need sign-off from Legal & Finance.
Carter: I can own SLA sign-off. Question: do we include uptime credit tiers or just incident credits? Prefer tiers.
Dina: Docs - SDK quickstarts + migration guide are staged in /docs/ga/lift-off. I need one more review for the metrics section.
Marta: Support rota — I'm on-call day 1, Carter can take escalation. We need runbook for cache evictions and model-fallback behavior.
Ben: Monitoring — alerts set: model-serving-error-rate > 0.5% for 5m, token-rate anomalies, KV cache miss spike. Grafana dashboard "GA-LiftOff" ready, panels for p50/p95/p99.
Alyssa: Proposed SLA blurb for public page (please sanity-check):
Ben: ```
SLA: 99.9% availability monthly. P99 latency <= 200ms (small models). Credits: 5% monthly credit for availability <99.9%, 10% for availability <99.0%.
```
Dina: Docs note — include explicit rollback instructions, canary URL, and how to disable caching if troubleshooting. Also add sample code for feature flags:
Dina: `redwood.rollout.canary=true`
Carter: Is pricing page ready? Finance confirmed MRR calc and per-token tiers, but public page needs an example invoice & quota examples for burst/committed plans.
Marta: I'll add example billing screenshots and a short FAQ entry for overages. Who will monitor billing spikes during rollout?
Ben: Ops will watch cost dashboards and we've wired automated alerts for >2x baseline spend in 15m. Also added an alert for sudden model-seat spikes.
Alyssa: Outstanding owners: SLA sign-off (Carter), Legal review (Ben), Docs final review (Dina), Support runbooks (Marta), Pricing publish (Carter + Finance). Can each reply 'ack' when done.
Carter: ack — starting SLA sign-off now, will loop Legal.
Dina: ack — docs review by EOD, will push updates to staging.
Marta: ack — runbooks in progress, will post link to /playbooks/runbooks and tag support.
Ben: ack — legal pinged and reviewing SLA blurb; chasing Finance on credit wording.
deploy-bot: Reminder: GA deploy scheduled at 2026-04-01T00:30:00Z. Canary window: 30m. Please ensure canary monitors are green before widening.
Alyssa: If anyone hits blockers call out in this thread, otherwise we'll proceed. :rocket:
